description: This line plot illustrates the similarity scores across different layers of a model, comparing four distinct configurations labeled en&en, en&el, en&es, and en&bn. The x-axis represents the “Layer” number, ranging from approximately 2 to 22, with tick marks at regular intervals of two units. The y-axis represents “Similarity,” scaled linearly from 0.05 to 0.45. The red line, corresponding to en&en, begins near 0.09 at layer 2, rises sharply to a peak of approximately 0.34 at layer 4, then declines slightly before increasing again to about 0.30 near layer 20 before sharply rising to nearly 0.45 at layer 22. The green line, en&el, starts near 0.06 at layer 2, peaks at approximately 0.23 around layer 4, then fluctuates before rising to about 0.25 near layer 20 before increasing to nearly 0.45 at layer 22. The blue line, en&es, begins near 0.08 at layer 2, rises to approximately 0.32 at layer 4, then declines slightly before rising to about 0.29 near layer 20 before increasing to nearly 0.45 at layer 22. The pink line, en&bn, starts near 0.07 at layer 2, peaks at approximately 0.22 around layer 4, then fluctuates before rising to about 0.25 near layer 20 before increasing to nearly 0.45 at layer 22. All four lines exhibit a general upward trend in similarity as the layer number increases, with all reaching a value of approximately 0.45 at layer 22.
